svg.text: From source change to a release artifact
Current workflow implementation · CI validates source and images · Release tags promote the tested manifest
pytest + demo + publication / provenance / unit gates
Ruff · ShellCheck · actionlint · Bicep · Markdown / links
PR image builds run the same tests and scan; they do not push to GHCR.
Publication boundary: exclude raw data, private replay and internal records; measure the public tree in a disposable copy.
* CodeQL runs in the public repository. Diagram describes code paths, not a completed release.
Separate workflows; release.yml verifies but does not create a Release.
